whatsappMessage:
Hi Team 32 Pearls Dental Clinic,

I noticed your dental clinic has a stellar 5.0★ rating in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new patient appointments.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, painless dental treatments showcase, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/32pearls

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team 32 Pearls Dental Clinic, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp appointment booking and mobile-first speed for patients searching in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
